sector_notes: Across Nov 12–18, the broad tape remained risk-off: SPY fell 3.56% and QQQ 4.16%, while Nov 18 breadth among U.S. stocks priced at least $5 with at least 500K shares traded was 1,368 advancers versus 1,463 decliners. Technology (XLK -5.73%), energy (XLE -4.73%), healthcare (XLV -3.55%) and financials (XLF -3.08%) were weakest; consumer staples (+0.13%) and utilities (-0.59%) held up best, while consumer discretionary rebounded 1.79% on Nov 18. S&P futures were up about 1.15% premarket on Nov 19 after a five-session losing streak, but that rebound is not yet confirmation of a trend reversal, so favor selective post-earnings leaders and relative-strength defensives.

earnings_flags.note: Fiscal Q3 2027 results are scheduled for release before the Nov 24 conference call; Dell Investor Relations confirms the event for 3:30 p.m. Central Time.
